sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:54

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:54:1
items.html: The lights of ZA remained clothed in these posterior of the upper AVI: For after the breaking of the vessels, up to the upper third of Tifferet, when all the posterior of the upper AVI had already descended, as above, and they expanded in the place of the vessels of HGT and were corrected in three lines, right, left and middle, then the lights of HGT rose and clothed in those vessels: the light of Hesed in the right line, the light of Gevura in the left line, and the light of the upper third of Tifferet in the middle line, as written below.
